description: The east half of the network effect-pool flood: 450 CORVROC (long-range rocket artillery, whose rockets stay in flight for seconds) on hold in a deep line at x 2850 on Two Continents, owned by the peer that applies it (owner 0 is always the local player). Apply limits-mp-west on one peer and limits-mp-east on the other, each on its own instance: in a network game every peer creates and owns its own units and TA replicates them, so a peer that creates another player's units makes units no peer owns. Built to push both peers' projectile and explosion pools past stock's 300 (tagpu_limits.h).
